# INV-USD from `a_usd_invoice_paid_from_the_usd_bank.txt`, read back with a
# second payment out of the same USD bank: 50.00 USD, all of it declared as a
# prepayment. The invoice's lot is closed, so the payment joins none and
# becomes the customer's credit.
customer "C-USD"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD"
	customer_id: "C-USD"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		memo: "Paid in dollars"
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-26
		amount: 50
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		prepayment: 50
		memo: "Paid again in dollars"
